1. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure __and a plurality of closed ribs flanking said open rib structure__; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure __and bonded thereto__.

2. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner __that are structurally distinct and non-contiguous__.

3. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first forward corner includes a first section of open rib structure and said second forward corner includes a second section of open rib structure __that are separated by at least one closed rib__.

4. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 3, including a first aero cover spanning and closing said first section of open rib structure and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second section of open rib structure __wherein each aero cover is independently removable__.

5. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 4, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib __at angles between 45 and 90 degrees__.

6. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 5, wherein said second section of open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib __at angles between 45 and 90 degrees__.

7. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 6, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs __and wherein said closed ribs extend continuously from a forward edge to a rearward edge of said body panel__.

8. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 7, including fasteners securing said first aero cover and said second aero cover to said body panel __wherein said fasteners are spaced at intervals of 25-50 mm__.

9. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 8, wherein said body panel includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress __that are integrally molded as part of said body panel__.

10. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 9, wherein said first section of open rib structure forms a part of said first buttress and said second section of open rib structure forms a part of said second buttress __and wherein said buttresses extend from a top surface to a bottom surface of said body panel__.

11. (Original) The belly pan of claim 10, wherein said body panel is made from a material having a tensile and flexural modulus of at least 7.8 GPa.

12. (Original) The belly pan of claim 11, wherein said body panel is molded from polypropylene reinforced with 40% long glass fibers.

13. (Original) The belly pan of claim 12, wherein said body panel has a thickness of about 3.5 mm.

14. (Original) The belly pan of claim 13, wherein said first aero cover and said second aero cover have a thickness of about 2.5 mm.

15. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress __wherein said open rib structures are separated by at least one closed rib__; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure __and bonded thereto__; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure __and bonded thereto__.

16. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 15, wherein said body panel includes a first section and a second section secured together by fasteners __wherein said first and second sections are independently molded components__.

17. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 16, wherein said first corner buttress is on said first section and said second corner buttress is on said second section __and wherein said buttresses are positioned at outer corners of said respective sections__.

18. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 17, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib __at angles between 45 and 90 degrees__.

19. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 18, wherein said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib __at angles between 45 and 90 degrees__.

20. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 19, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs __and wherein said closed ribs extend continuously across the width of said body panel__.
